title: Virtual Card Management: Integrating Virtual Cards with Expense Management Tools
summary: Explains how to integrate Virtual Cards with accounting/expense platforms: up to 12 supported platforms, real-time transaction updates via alerts (event forwarding), and syncing card nicknames so vendor/project labels carry into your expense system. Covers setup steps, field mapping, and initial sync/backfill.
